description: Show a sync plan made by plan_sync, before or after it is applied. With plan_id: the plan as plan_sync returned it (totals, ops with field changes, warnings, expiry) plus, once applied, the apply's state and totals; only the first 200 ops are listed and long values are shortened unless full=true, and format="markdown" gives a report to share for review. Without plan_id: the 20 most recent plans (plan_id, createdAt, status, source, target, op count), to find one. To create a plan use plan_sync, to write it use apply_plan, and to follow a running apply use apply_status. Reads only the plans saved by this server, nothing from Shopify.

format.description: "markdown" returns the plan as a report, to share before applying it.

full.description: List every op with full values (default: first 200 ops, long values shortened).

plan_id.description: The plan to show, as returned by plan_sync. Omit to list the recent plans.

name: get_plan
title: Get a plan
